integrity: The counterexample is established by an explicit partition and an exact reconstruction proof; finite-prefix computations were used only as diagnostics and are not evidence for the infinite claim.
limitations: The construction is proved for the displayed neutral diagonal family, not for every neutral nonexpanding toral endomorphism.
No independence, Rokhlin property, alphabet minimality, or everywhere point-separation is claimed.
An equivalent comparison coding may exist in older general generator literature not surfaced by the checked searches.
title: Smooth finite generators for neutral toral factors
